main_text.l: weichbild. Sub Rubric. Gros eltern sind näher
Erben zunemmen / dann schwester oder brüder. Vide
Schneidcvvinum[?].
Sequentes Regulae de parentum natu-
ralium successione sunt ob-
servandae.
Pater naturalis tantum, solus existens, filio natu-
rali extincto, succedit in duabus unciis, hoc est, sexta
parte hereditatis. Authen. licet. §. ab intestato. C. de
naturalibus liber.
Mater vero & alij ascendentes lineae maternae, eidem
filio defuncto æque succedere possunt, ac si ex legi-
timo matrimonio natus esset. §. final. inst. de SC. Ter-
tyllian. & l. si spuriis. ff. unde cognati.
Sequentes Regulae de successione le-
gitimorum parentum tan-
tum sunt obser-
vandae.
Facta adoptione ab extraneo, filio defuncto, pater
naturalis patri adoptivo in ejus hæreditatis succes-
sione præfertur: sed defuncto adoptato ab ascenden-
te, adoptivus pater exclufo, naturali, eidem succedit.
l. cum in adoptivis. §. sed ne articulum. C. de ado-
ptionibus.
Pater arrogante solo superstite post obitum filij
arrogati, tota ejus hæreditas ad eundem solum de-
volvitur: sed si vixerit adhuc arrogati
pater natura-lis,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Schneidcvvinum" (the letter after "Schneid" may be e; marked [?]). The top line of black letter is read as printed. The ornamental mark after "Prima Regula" and "Secunda Regula" in the heading was read as a flourish and not transcribed. A stray mark (a dash and a small stroke) lies at the bottom centre of the page and is not text. The left edge of the scan shows the dark background and page edge, which are omitted. The "|" in "ejus|hæreditatis" is read as a line-break mark and not kept.
